snippet.title: Game Preview Trailer | Open World Action RPG 2026
snippet.description:
Two creators. Zero investors. One world.
Eternal Blade is an open world action RPG set in the Baransu Realm — four years of universe building, now playable.
Combat. Voice acting. Hunting. Fishing. Exploring. A story worth fighting for.
Free alpha launching in 2026.
